Specification: This module is a regression and validation test specification for operators provided by the FiniteSetsExt extension module, together with TLC-related support modules. It asserts expected semantic properties of set-processing operators such as Quantify, kSubset, FoldSet, ChooseUnique, SymDiff, SumSet, ProductSet, ReduceSet, and FlattenSet over both numeric and string-valued sets. The file is not a behavioral system specification in practice; instead it consists almost entirely of ASSUME statements that serve as executable tests, plus a commented-out dummy Init/Next pair noted as unnecessary scaffolding for TLC behavior exploration.
AssumptionNames: LET T == INSTANCE TLC IN T!PrintT("FiniteSetsExtTests")

LET S == {"a","b","c","c"}
       IN Quantify(S, LAMBDA s: s = "c") = Cardinality({s \in S : s = "c"})

\A S \in SUBSET {"a","b","c","c"} :
          Quantify(S, LAMBDA s: s = "c") = Cardinality({s \in S : s = "c"})

\A S \in SUBSET {"a","b","c","c"} :
          Quantify(S, LAMBDA s: FALSE) = Cardinality({s \in S : FALSE})

LET S == 1..10
       IN Quantify(S, LAMBDA s: s = 3) = Cardinality({s \in S : s = 3})

LET S == 1..2000000
       IN Quantify(S, LAMBDA s: TRUE) = Cardinality(S)

LET S == {"a","b","c","c"}
       IN kSubset(-1, S) = {} /\ kSubset(4, S) = {}

LET T == 1..3
       IN \A k \in (1..Cardinality(T)):
            /\ \A e \in { ss \in (SUBSET T) : Cardinality(ss) = k} :
                     e \in kSubset(k, T)
            /\ \A e \in { ss \in (SUBSET T) : Cardinality(ss) # k} :
                     e \notin kSubset(k, T)

LET T == 1..3
           kSubsetPure(k, S) == { s \in SUBSET S : Cardinality(s) = k }
       IN \A k \in 1..Cardinality(T):
                /\ ((SUBSET T) \subseteq kSubsetPure(k, T)) <=> ((SUBSET T) \subseteq kSubset(k, T))
                /\ kSubsetPure(k, T) \subseteq (SUBSET T) <=> kSubset(k, T) \subseteq (SUBSET T)

AssertError(
           "Attempted to compute the value of an expression of form\nCHOOSE x \\in S: P, but no element of S satisfied P.\nline 163, col 26 to line 164, col 64 of module FiniteSetsExt", 
           ChooseUnique({2, 3, 4, 5}, LAMBDA x : TRUE))

AssertError(
           "Attempted to compute the value of an expression of form\nCHOOSE x \\in S: P, but no element of S satisfied P.\nline 163, col 26 to line 164, col 64 of module FiniteSetsExt", 
           ChooseUnique({}, LAMBDA x : TRUE))

AssertError(
           "Attempted to compute the value of an expression of form\nCHOOSE x \\in S: P, but no element of S satisfied P.\nline 163, col 26 to line 164, col 64 of module FiniteSetsExt", 
           ChooseUnique({2, 3, 4, 5}, LAMBDA x : FALSE))
